### **Position Overview:**

The Data Scientist will be responsible for analyzing complex datasets, developing advanced statistical models, and building machine learning solutions to support data-driven business decisions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Python, statistical analysis, machine learning, predictive modeling, and data visualization. This role involves identifying business trends, developing algorithms, performing experiments, and transforming raw data into actionable insights that improve business performance and operational efficiency.

### **Data Science Technologies & Technical Expertise:**

* Strong programming experience with Python and data science libraries.
* Hands-on experience with Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Scikit-learn, and Matplotlib.
* Experience with machine learning algorithms, including regression, classification, clustering, and ensemble methods.
* Strong knowledge of supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning techniques.
* Experience with statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, probability, and predictive modeling.
* Knowledge of deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Keras.
* Experience with Natural Language Processing (NLP), text analytics, and sentiment analysis.
* Familiarity with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and RAG architectures.
* Proficiency in SQL and experience working with relational and NoSQL databases.
* Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Plotly.
* Knowledge of big data technologies such as Apache Spark, PySpark, and Hadoop.
* Familiarity with MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, and model deployment pipelines.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS SageMaker, Azure Machine Learning, or Google Vertex AI.
* Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.

### **Key Data Science Responsibilities:**

* Collect, process, analyze, and interpret large structured and unstructured datasets.
* Develop statistical models and machine learning algorithms to solve business problems.
* Build predictive models for forecasting, classification, recommendation, and optimization.
* Perform data cleaning, preprocessing, feature engineering, and exploratory data analysis.
* Identify patterns, trends, correlations, and anomalies within complex datasets.
* Apply statistical techniques and hypothesis testing to validate business assumptions.
* Develop NLP and deep learning solutions for text-based and unstructured data.
* Evaluate model performance using appropriate metrics and optimization techniques.
* Deploy machine learning models into production environments in collaboration with engineering teams.
* Monitor model performance and implement continuous improvements.
* Create visualizations, reports, and dashboards to communicate analytical findings.
* Collaborate with data engineers, machine learning engineers, business analysts, and stakeholders.
* Maintain technical documentation and follow responsible AI and data governance practices.

### **Experience & Professional Competencies:**

* 6+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Advanced Analytics, or related fields.
* 4+ years of hands-on experience using Python for data analysis and model development.
* Strong experience developing statistical models and machine learning algorithms.
* Practical knowledge of predictive analytics, feature engineering, and model evaluation.
* Experience working with large datasets and multiple data sources.
* Understanding of statistical concepts, probability, mathematics, and optimization techniques.
* Experience deploying and monitoring machine learning models is preferred.
* Exposure to cloud-based AI/ML platforms and MLOps practices is an advantage.
* Strong analytical thinking, research, and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to present technical findings to business stakeholders.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.

jobs.title: AI Software Engineer - Calendar Intelligence
jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
Apple has changed how people live, connect, and work, and the Calendar team wants to rethink what a calendar can do for the people using it. A calendar knows when someone is busy. It knows very little about which of those commitments matter, which ones could move, or when would be a good time for something new. We're looking for an engineer to help answer those questions, on device and privately, for billions of people. The right person has strong machine learning foundations and is just as comfortable writing the software that ships a model as building the model itself. You'll help take ideas from a single sentence to a shipped feature, and you'll bring the evaluation that tells us whether it works.
  
  
Description
  
  
In this role you'll drive the modeling and evaluation behind intelligence features in Calendar, from the first framing through launch, as part of a very collaborative team. A request will often start as one line, and you'll work with the team to turn it into a problem we can solve: what signal exists, what a good answer looks like, which approach fits, and how we'll know it's right. You'll design the evaluation before you build the model. That means the metrics, the eval sets, the baselines a model has to beat, and human review for the places where a metric can't tell you enough. You won't always have good data, so part of the job is finding it and getting something useful out of it when there isn't much. You'll need to get real statistical strength out of priors, shared structure, and self-supervision. You'll also work with a range of large language models, on device and on server, deciding where a model call earns its cost, where a smaller model trained on a larger model's judgments does better, and where a well-tuned heuristic beats both. You'll join a small team of senior systems engineers who ship this work across Apple's platforms, several of them with deep backgrounds in ML data engineering. There's no hard line between roles, so you'll write production code alongside them in whatever part of the stack the problem needs. Calendar also builds on signals and models from other ML teams across Apple, and a lot of this role is working with them: building on what they have, agreeing on shared interfaces, and recognizing when we need our own. You'll work closely with design and product as well. We need someone who writes clearly, can explain a model's tradeoffs to engineers who aren't ML specialists, and is comfortable driving a problem forward before the path is defined.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, EE, Applied Mathematics, or related field with 2+ years experience in developing ML / AI driven software.
* Proficiency in one or more of the following programming languages: Python, Swift, Objective-C, or C++
* Experience developing software prototypes and features driven by Large Language Models and designing tool and function-calling interfaces, constructing context, and validating model output
* Fluency with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, with good judgment about where to apply them and how to verify what they produce.
* Experience driving an ambiguous problem with cross-functional partners, including other ML teams, from a loose idea through launch, and getting alignment on shared interfaces along the way.
* Exceptional problem-solving skills, and the ability to drive alignment across teams on shared API surfaces

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Experience designing and developing systems that are efficient in resource constrained environments — latency, memory, and power budgets on device
* Solid foundation in machine learning, probability, and statistics, with hands-on experience training and evaluating models in a framework such as PyTorch or JAX
* A track record of designing the evaluation for what you ship: metrics, held-out sets, baselines, and noticing when a metric has stopped measuring what you care about
* Proven ability to excel in a fast-paced development team
